source_caption_text:
Offset opens up about being portrayed as the “VILLAIN” following his relationship with Cardi B, revealing that the two are actually on good terms and respect each other’s privacy. ❤️👀

“I’m very considerate of her. As long as I’m good with her, she’s good with me, and our kids good.”

Offset explained that they now live separate lives, but that doesn’t mean there’s bad blood between them.

“It’s 2 different worlds now. I would never want to conjoin that and put her at discomfort.”

He also suggested that fans sometimes make things more uncomfortable by constantly involving themselves in their personal lives. 💯
